summary: File the aging example masuli under syw III.
before: ono zlām qášo-no w masuli, w ʕəmri básli-yo
rationale: The target verb masuli “I have grown old” is already attested under syw III, with base forms masule/masu and the sense alt werden: uno masuli at 24/48 and omər uʕdo masuli at JL 9.9.7. It is the same form and meaning. The leveling verb swy II has different forms msawele/msawe and meaning einebnen; the LB 42 example belongs with syw III.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/62)

data.turoyo: Hən nuqliwa, ŭ hən maḥtiwa hul dmiswewa bu+ṭino. Šayʕíwayle hawxa.
data.translation: Some would bring it, and some would put it until it would get level with clay. They would smooth it out like so.

rationale: New Detransitive Infectum-wa box.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) eben, gerade werden/sein

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (JTM 1.1/40)

data.turoyo: Mənayye kmakələnne, mənayye taxmini. D howe daworo kayiso, reǧbar mahər, bu dworo, bu ʕiyono kəmqasəm i dukṯo, w koṯən ar rezat msawye. Bəṯr məd u daworano mṣaylable i arʕo, kmusakle fuʕle, dukṯe daṣ ṣəllabatanək kfotəḥ nuqre.
data.translation: Manche messen sie ab, andere machen es nach Schätzung. Wenn jemand ein guter Pflüger ist, ein Bauer, der beim Pflügen geschickt ist, dann teilt er den Platz nach Augenmaß ein, und die Reihen (der Weinstöcke) werden gerade. Wenn der Pflüger den Acker eingeteilt hat, nimmt er sich Hilfsarbeiter und gräbt an den Stellen, wo sich die Linien kreuzen, Löcher.

rationale: Thin physical Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; crop-row and level-surface contexts.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (JTM 1.1/53)

data.turoyo: W kəmhawri ʕal tloṯ-arbaʕ niše mə daǧ ǧiran dəṯṯe, kmanṭən baṯ ṯawbe du čapan, kmaydi u ḥawdalano bas saṭle, d lə qoyər, d kkufxile, kul ṯawbo saṭlo aw tre xd u mede, xd u yurwo du čapan w kəmlawləbile an niše w kmakrəxile ʕal u čapanawo kule w kfursile b dukṯo msawayto. W u ṯawbo bu ṯawbo hawxa.
data.translation: Sie rufen drei, vier Frauen aus ihrer Nachbarschaft, bringen Leinentücher, nehmen den ḥawdal in Eimern, damit er nicht abkühlt, und gießen ihn (auf die Tücher), (auf) jedes Tuch einen Eimer oder zwei, entsprechend der Größe des Leinentuchs. Die Frauen bewegen den ḥawdal auf dem Leinentuch hin und her und lassen ihn über das ganze Tuch fließen und breiten es auf einer ebenen Stelle aus, ein Leinentuch nach dem anderen.

rationale: Thin physical Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; crop-row and level-surface contexts.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Hanna Dewo/163)

data.turoyo: ḤD. ŭ kə́twaylan šəndan, diqo bi+arʕo, ŭ čakučat, ŭ, ŭ msawí … ŭ msawíwayna as+sefoqe appe, msawíwayna as+sefoqe appe.
data.translation: HD. And we had a hanvil, it was stuck in the ground, and hammers, and, and we smooth … and we used to smooth utensils with them, we used to smooth utensils with them.

rationale: Thin active Infectum-wa/1 cell; complementary actor/object and instrument frames.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Hanna Dewo/164)

data.translation: Did you used to smooth utensils with hammers?

rationale: Thin active Infectum-wa/1 cell; complementary actor/object and instrument frames.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Hanna Dewo/165)

data.turoyo: ḤD. E, msawíwayna bač+čakučat, bu+doquqo, b̥kul mede. Saymíwaynanne, yani msawíwaynanne, e.
data.translation: Yes, we used to smooth them out with hammers, with mallets, with everything. We used to make them, that is, we used to smooth them out, right.

rationale: Thin active Infectum-wa/1 cell; complementary actor/object and instrument frames.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Interview 2/151)

data.turoyo: Msawíwayna hawxa i+arʕo, maḥtíwayna hawxa arʕayye bdŭkṯo rakuto, molíwaynanne ʕafro.
data.translation: We would level the ground like so, we would put their bottoms like so on a flat spot, we would fill them with soil.

rationale: Thin active Infectum-wa/1 cell; complementary actor/object and instrument frames.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Talay 1/174)

data.turoyo: ʕAyni maḥṣalle u naqwawo, rəmarəm dak kefe hawi, maḥatte ad dape, mlalle u ʕafro w ak kefe ʕəl me ḥḏoḏe msawalle.
data.translation: Sie verschlossen die Öffnung wieder. Ich hörte die Geräusche der Steine. Sie verlegten die Holzbretter und füllten Erde und Steine darüber und ebneten (die Stelle der Öffnung).

rationale: Thin active Preterit/1; completed levelling of a covering.

summary: example for sense 1b in Part. Pass. (MAC Ishaq old houses/86)

data.turoyo: W bəṯr qolabwa li+kefo, law miḏaʕwa, laybux furšatle bəṯr me zabno dḥamši+əšne aw mo+əšne, edi howewa xdi+kefo. Laybux dəḏʕat, lo i+kefo áynayo, w lo ayna loyo. Ktowe msawyo ʕam+ḥḏoḏe, lo+kfərqatle. Laybux furšatle me ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: And after it turned into stone, it was no longer recognizable, you cannot distinguish it after a period of fifty years or a hundred years, then it has become like stone. You cannot recognize either which is the stone or which is not. It becomes equal to one another, you cannot separate it. You cannot distinguish one from another.

rationale: Example of the accepted figurative Detransitive subsense.

summary: example for sense 1c in Part. Pass. (PrS 80/44)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Kəḏʕət, aḥna a broze lə kəmdaglina, u xabrayḏan w i lašayḏan msawye ne." Omər: "Ṭrowe."
data.translation: "Du weisst, wir Eber lügen nicht, unsere Rede und unser Körper sind gerade aus." "Gut!" erwiderte der Fuchs

rationale: Example of the accepted figurative Detransitive subsense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (94/311)

data.turoyo: Kul ḥamšo, əšto kowən ġurub, kul ḥa komaqimənne čarxi, bu rez kowən msawye d ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Je fünf oder sechs bilden eine Partei. Jede stellt ein fünf Piasterstück auf, so, daß diese eine Reihe bilden und gleichen Abstand voneinander haben.

rationale: Physical row alignment; do not import equal-spacing meaning from German.

summary: example for sense 2 in Part. Pass. (JTM 5.2/103)

data.turoyo: komər alo hule i səsto, hano rawəx ʕal i səsto, i səsto raqiḏo taḥte, məlle ha haṯe haha. omər aṯi. aṯi bəṯr u ʕammo, məlle lu ʕammo, məlle ʕammo tamam yo, u mede d ǧġəlina kule tamam yo, d ǧġilo ʕamṯi. gəburamno bəṯrux bu dəyar, uno gəduʕanno hawxa mi xasra du diyar w hat hawxa, w msawyo ʕal i qriṯo. nafəxnar mənayye lə kmaflətina.
data.translation: Da gab er die Stute heraus, dieser bestieg die Stute, und die Stute tanzte unter ihm, er sagte: Ja, die ist es, genau. Er kam und suchte den Onkel, er sagte zu dem Onkel: Onkel, es stimmt. Was wir besprochen haben, stimmt alles, d.h. was meine Tante gesagt hat. Ich werde hinter dir um den Hügel herumreiten, ich werde so von der Seite des Hügels zurückkommen, und du so, und dann (geht’s) geradewegs ins Dorf. Wir lassen nicht den geringsten von ihnen übrig.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./2; adverb modifies motion, not a levelling patient.

summary: example for sense 2 in Part. Pass. (PrS 50/88)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Ayko azze?" Ummo: "Msawyo." Azze laf gnayte d yawmo, mḥalaqle bəṯre, azze.
data.translation: "Wohin ist er gegangen?" "Geradeaus in der Richtung nach Westen." Kandar eilte ihm nach.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./2; adverb modifies motion, not a levelling patient.

summary: example for sense 2 in Part. Pass. (26/179)

data.turoyo: Maḥwelalən u šuqo, i ǧaʕda ayko yo, w msawyo məblila hul u tarʕo du abro du ʕammo.
data.translation: Sie zeigte ihnen, wo der Markt und die Straße war, und führte sie geradeswegs bis zur Tür ihres Vetters.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./2; adverb modifies motion, not a levelling patient.

summary: example for sense 2 in Part. Pass. (44/71)

data.turoyo: Itax ʕam a ṭlawḥe, gdoṯat gabi msawyo!" Əmmo: "Ṭowo!"
data.translation: Geh du den Linsen nach, dann kommst du geradenwegs zu mir!" Sie sprach: "Gut!"

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass./2; adverb modifies motion, not a levelling patient.

summary: The inherited entry lacks a numbered Detransitive sense list despite Detransitive boxes. New Detransitive labels specify the physical and adverbial uses without changing active II.1.
Instrumental b- and pronominal appe mark hammers/mallets in active straightening. Result-state msawyo/msawye/msawayto can be attributive or predicative and does not by itself imply a narrated agent.
dmiswewa supplies new Detransitive Infectum-wa. msawéwaylan is too uncertain between L-agent and an altered habitual form to establish Preterit-wa.
Existing syw and the inherited swy III block must be reconciled independently of swy II levelling. Ambiguous Lahdo Traitor 2/33 msawyo is not reliable evidence for either meaning.
Round 2 is based on the supplied Jan Turoyo; accompanying English is project machine translation [MT]. Round 1 was read first and its proposals are not duplicated.

All secure Jan uses belong to II levelling, independent of the disputed inherited III ageing block. Round 1 already raised physical Detransitive Part. Pass. sense 1 to five after moving the inherited adverbial token to Detransitive 2. No Jan physical example is needed simply to fill a thin cell.

msawayto wa marks a level-state property with an external past copula (Jan 2.4/877), not an automatic finite Preterit-wa. Participial forms can describe surfaces, an orarion end and a metaphorical path.

msawanwo with burned shops/houses/churches and ʕam i arʕo (Jan 3.12/122) strongly suggests levelling, but its exact form is unresolved. Round 1 already establishes Detransitive Infectum-wa from dmiswewa; do not claim another missing-box discovery.

səwoyo after ksayminale (Jan 2.4/889) and šawye d dawme (2.4/890) require separate nominal/adjectival analysis. šwy lookup gives winding and worthiness entries, neither a secure match for the tampers. Source spelling is retained without emendation.
Confirm swy versus syw for the inherited III ageing block and whether Lahdo Traitor 2/33 msawyo means a direct gesture or 'aged'.
At MAC Ishaq Material culture/76 verify -waylan versus -wayna before admitting a Preterit-wa box.

At MAC Ishaq Material culture/64 confirm purpose dəmsawalle as Infectum with object suffix and following msawalle as Preterit; retain these as provisional without using the ambiguous tokens as new-form evidence.
Is PrS 80/44 straight speech a conventional truthfulness expression or a story-specific pun?
At 94/311 does msawye d ḥḏoḏe specify common alignment, height or spacing? Only physical alignment is accepted here.
Is səwoyo (Jan 2.4/889) a levelling noun, a level adjective, or another item? Confirm before adding Infinitiv, and do not infer Detransitive voice from the English.
Check šawye (Jan 2.4/890) against the source and establish its lexeme; no evidence currently licenses normalizing it to msawye.
Resolve msawanwo (Jan 3.12/122): reduced Detransitive Infectum-wa, active plural, Detransitive Preterit-wa, or adjective with a copula?
Does msawyo at Jan 4.I/582 mean straight, level, or already prepared? A prepared-path lexical sense is not established by the supplied line.
Physical levelling/straightening applies to earth, roofs, crop rows, tools and metal vessels. Coin alignment at 94/311 stays physical; equal spacing cannot be established from the Turoyo alone.
Detransitive Part. Pass. msawyo on a spiritual or future path extends the physical straight/level property. Jan 3.56/1620 explicitly glosses raṣt with (msawyo); no new sense.
The orarion arrangement retains the physical straight property, alongside floors and roofs already covered after round 1.
